change_summary: Route only late turns (index >= 6) to gpt-4.1-mini while keeping gpt-4.1 for early reasoning-heavy turns via a thread-local turn counter.
reason_for_change: Blanket mini routing failed (pass_rate 0.4167) because early turns need strong reasoning, but late turns (recaps, confirmations, goodbyes) are verbose and low-risk. Costliest tasks (103=$0.082, 99=$0.068) have many turns, so discounting late-turn tokens to gpt-4.1-mini cuts mean cost per task while preserving strong-model accuracy on the early turns that drove the failures, keeping success above the floor.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — crossed success guardrail: pass_rate 0.5000 < floor 0.5410
hypothesis: Selectively routing only the final execution/confirmation turns to gpt-4.1-mini while keeping gpt-4.1 for reasoning-heavy early turns (turn-count-gated routing) captures most token cost on late verbose turns without the accuracy loss that caused the blanket-mini rejection.
